defaults.description: Use default values for unspecified groups

dir.description: Child working directory (must exist); default is the server's cwd. This is not target authority.

dryRun.description: Prepare a plan without changing files

noEnvSetup.description: Don't offer or run env setup after creation (--no-env-setup)

projectContext.description: Exact authenticated installed context key; omitted uses registration default

ref.description: Template reference: repo/name@version or short name

sourceInput.description: Path to the closed JSON source selection

targetDir.description: Target locator forwarded as --dir; may be absent. Relative paths resolve against child dir. Must equal selected installed root.

yes.description: Automatically confirm CLI actions (--yes), including missing tools installation and env setup
